L. M. Montgomery, Anne of the Island.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/l-m-montgomery/anne-of-the-island

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- L. M. Montgomery, the author, died 1942.

First publication of the text used: 1915 (SE colophon: 'Anne of the Island was published in 1915 by L. M. Montgomery.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1915, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2010.
- Country of origin (the facts do not name the country of first publication; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each of these countries has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1942, so the text is public domain in each of them from 1 January 2013 at the latest.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
